Wir bieten auch kostenlose wöchentliche professionelle Sprachkurse an.</p> <p><strong>🌍Mach einen Unterschied</strong><strong><br></strong>Du wirst in einer großartigen Startup-Umgebung arbeiten, mit der Freiheit, eigene Projekte voranzutreiben und sichtbare Erfolge zu erzielen. Neben der Möglichkeit, mit Picnic-Kolleg:innen zu sprechen, die als vertrauliche Berater:innen fungieren, gibt dir unsere Zusammenarbeit mit OpenUp einfachen Zugang zu professionellen Psycholog:innen sowie zu Workshops und Materialien.<br>Es gibt viele Sportgemeinschaften und Veranstaltungen, bei denen du mitmachen kannst – von Beachvolleyball über Yoga bis hin zum Klettern!</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/htFHRsAGOas?si=xNz2xzdNPhUFkW9R" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p><em>Only about 1% of our applicants end up in the offer stage. To increase your chances, give yourself a competitive edge and come fully prepared!</em></p> <h2>In a nutshell</h2> <p>As we are building the best milkman on earth, we are looking for sharp minds that can help us further shape Picnic as we expand across Europe. We are looking for experienced hires with a background in top strategy consulting, private equity, investment banking, e-commerce or commercial roles, that can help us capitalize on the many growth opportunities Picnic has.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2>Your superpowers</h2> <ul> <li>Master’s degree in Econometrics, Engineering, Finance, Math or an equivalent quantitative study</li> <li>2-5 years of work experience in top tier management consulting, PE, investment banking, retail topics and hands-on deal experience</li> <li>Out-of-the-box thinking and initiative: hands-on, nothing-is-impossible mindset</li> <li>Strong communication skills in German and English, allowing you to explain complex analytical concepts in a simple and practical way</li> <li>Proficient with SQL and Python or excited to learn</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>🏆 <strong>Rewarding Impact from Day One</strong></p> <p>You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.</p> <p><strong>🍎Learning &amp; development&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You'll always have something to learn with us! You’ll benefit from opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already know. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>🗺️Relocation</strong></p> <p>If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.</p> <p><strong>⛳All the rest&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.</p> <h2>FAQ</h2> <p><strong>Which team will I join?</strong></p> <p>At Picnic, we build almost everything in-house. This means that we have plenty of opportunities for you in terms of project topics. Your interest lies in consumer topics like pricing, assortment, customer life time value? Or rather in logistics, supply chain, automated warehousing areas? Or you'd love going adventurous into new areas as long as you're solving real world problems? Let's talk and figure it out where there's the best match.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What are the long term opportunities for this role? What happens after I'm done with a project?</strong></p> <p>You get full accountability from the start: from shaping the strategy and driving step-change improvements, to collaborating with multiple teams to achieve tangible business results.</p> <p>At Picnic, the long-term opportunity isn't just a role—it’s a platform to shape your own career trajectory with real ownership, business impact, and fast growth. Hence the career paths are as diverse as your ambitions. Depending on your interests and strengths, these are most common career paths we’ve seen so far:</p> <ul> <li>Given our scale-up environment, many projects tend to grow in scope and complexity under your responsibility and you naturally grow a team around you in order to take your project to a next level.</li> <li>As you grow, you’ll deepen your understanding of the business, build a strong internal network, and prove your ability to lead impactful projects. Once you feel you’ve learned everything in your scope and your projects have been successfully implemented, you can switch to complete different areas of Picnic. We have numerous colleagues that have switched from Commercial to Fulfillment, or from Distribution to Customer and many other examples.</li> </ul> <p><strong>In what language should I apply?</strong></p> <p>Please send your application in English.&nbsp;</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/6TXqRcPPJM4?si=WKbhweTel2Oll1Hq" width="560" height="315"></iframe></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Mit&nbsp;<strong>logischem Denken</strong> und smarten Automatisierungstools machst du unsere Prozesse jeden Tag ein Stückchen besser. Du arbeitest eng mit Category, Brand und <strong>cross-funktionalen Teams zusammen</strong>, um Lieferengpässe zu lösen, Daten zu checken und dafür zu sorgen, dass unsere App für die KundInnen immer perfekt gepflegt ist.</p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Artikelerstellung &amp; Onboarding:</strong> Du übernimmst die Anlage und Erstellung neuer Produkte im System und stellst sicher, dass alle notwendigen Informationen vom ersten Tag an korrekt und für unsere KundInnen bereit sind.</li> <li><strong>Tool-Support &amp; Validierung:</strong> Du begleitest die Einführung und Nutzung unseres neuen Automatisierungstools. Als wichtige Instanz für die Qualitätskontrolle hinterfragst du Prozesse kritisch und stellst sicher, dass die Systemausgaben korrekt sind.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Produkt-Performance-Monitoring:</strong> Du behältst Verkaufs- und Bestandsanomalien genau im Auge. Wenn ein Top-Priority-Artikel sich nicht verkauft oder als nicht verfügbar angezeigt wird, tauchst du ins System ein, um die Ursache zu finden, damit unsere digitalen Regale immer den maximalen Umsatz erzielen.</li> <li><strong>Content- &amp; Storefront-Optimierung:</strong> Wenn unvollständige Produktpräsentationen den Verkauf hemmen, reagierst du schnell und taktisch – z. B. durch das schnelle Beheben von fehlenden Produktfotos oder unvollständigen Artikelinfos in der App.</li> <li><strong>Lieferkette &amp; Inbound-Abstimmung:</strong> Du unterstützt das Team bei täglichen kommerziellen Fragen zur Lieferkette und klärst Probleme bei der Produktanlieferung, um einen reibungslosen Ablauf in deinen Kategorien zu garantieren.</li> <li><strong>Teamarbeit:</strong> Du bietest starke operative Unterstützung über verschiedene Prioritätsstufen hinweg und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit dem gesamten Category-Team, um die täglichen Aufgaben optimal zu balancieren.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Fortgeschrittenes Bachelorstudium oder aktuell im Master in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, E-Commerce, Supply Chain Management, Volkswirtschaftslehre oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.</li> <li>Ein scharfes Auge fürs Detail, starkes logisches Denkvermögen und eine natürliche Neugier, um hinter die Kulissen zu blicken und operative Rätsel zu lösen.</li> <li>Exzellente organisatorische Fähigkeiten, eine proaktive Einstellung zur Übernahme von Verantwortung und Routine im Umgang mit täglichen Arbeitsabläufen.</li> <li>Eine echte Affinität für die Lebensmittelbranche und Begeisterung für die Arbeit mit neuer Software Systemen.</li> <li>Zeit, unser Team für <strong>16 - 20 Stunden</strong> pro Woche zu unterstützen.</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.</strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte mit uns durch: </strong>Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung: </strong>Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück und Mittagessen in unserem Büro, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Ein moderner Workspace:</strong> Unser neu renoviertes Büro ist auf Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt und bietet dir flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie 30 Urlaubstage (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche).</li> <li><strong>Wohlbefinden &amp; Gleichgewicht:</strong> Wir bieten dir professionelle Unterstützung für deine mentale Gesundheit mit OpenUp. Und dank unseres hundefreundlichen Büros ist dein vierbeiniger Begleiter nach Absprache willkommen.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit - inklusive Laptop sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und unsere Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Attraktive Vergütung:</strong> Als WerkstudentIn verdienst du 14,75 €/Std. (Bachelor) bzw. 15,50 €/Std. (Master) und sammelst spannende Praxiserfahrung.</li> </ul> <p>Schick uns deine Bewerbung gern auf Englisch, wenn du schon eine englische Version parat hast.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description: <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2><strong>Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one.</strong></h2> <p>Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex<strong>,</strong> real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech?&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics</strong> at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.</p> <p>At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. <br>We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.</p> <h2><strong>Tricks of the trade</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead with ambition</strong>: Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.</li> <li><strong>Steep learning curve</strong>: Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.</li> <li><strong>Solve real-life puzzles</strong>: Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.</li> <li><strong>Innovate across borders</strong>: You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.</li> <li><strong>High-performance environment</strong>: You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>From learning to leading</strong></h2> <p>Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.</p> <p>You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.</p> <p>As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.</p> <h3><strong>Where you’ll make an impact</strong></h3> <p>From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Consumer</strong> - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Logistics </strong>- Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your superpowers</strong></h2> <p>You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.<br><br>More specifically, you:</p> <ul> <li>Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a <strong>quantitative field</strong>: e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar</li> <li>Have experience in <strong>high-performance environments:</strong> consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar</li> <li>Show an <strong>entrepreneurial mindset</strong>: you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked</li> <li><strong>Think like a builder</strong>: hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions</li> <li>You have already gained basic knowledge in <strong>PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel</strong> or alternative coding languages&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>EU citizenship</strong> or valid <strong>EU working permit required</strong>.</li> </ul> <p><em>Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. </em><em>We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective.</em></p> <h2><strong>&nbsp;</strong><strong>Why Picnic?</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Grow as we grow</strong>. We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours</li> <li><strong>Work with other innovators.&nbsp;</strong>Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)</li> <li><strong>Kickstart your career.&nbsp;</strong>Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic</li> </ul> <h3><strong>When are you joining?&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Fall Edition 2026<br></strong>Start dates: September, October<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Winter Edition 2026<br></strong>Start dates: November, December<br><em>*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question</em></li> </ul> <p>📍 Location: Full-time in Hamburg, with periodic trips to NL or FR<br><br><span style="text-decoration: underline;">There is no </span><strong><span style="text-decoration: underline;">deadline</span>:</strong> Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Picnic Perks&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p>🏆 <strong>Rewarding Impact from Day One</strong></p> <p>You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.</p> <p><strong>🍎Learning &amp; development&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our <strong>Future Leaders Graduate Program - Business Analytics</strong> is designed to offer you a steep learning curve by taking business ownership and end-to-end responsibility early on. You’ll get to learn by doing, while mentored by our Picnic leaders that had a similar journey like you. Next to that, you’ll benefit from other opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already do in this program. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>🗺️Relocation</strong></p> <p>If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation.&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;<strong>🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.</p> <p><strong>⛳All the rest&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. We subsidise your Deutschlandticket and with the Lease-a-Bike you can get to work sustainably and healthily. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.</p> <h3><strong>FAQ</strong></h3> <p><strong>Do I need a quantitative background? </strong>It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a <strong>Master's degree</strong>, basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.</p> <p><strong>Does the program include rotations?</strong> No, intentionally.   • Du bist Student:in im dritten Semester im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Eventmanagement, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Studiengang

description: Deine Rolle bei uns Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung. In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte. Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen. Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen. Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung. Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick. Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen. Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden. Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab. Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei. Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern. Beraten & Wissen vermitteln Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter digitaler Lösungen und Technologien. Du begleitest bei Bedarf Ausschreibungen, Angebotsbewertungen und Beschaffungsprozesse. Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf und unterstützt Anwender durch Workshops, Schulungen und geeignete Materialien. Was du mitbringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in digitalen Projekten, IT-Projekten, Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbaren Rollen mit eigener Verantwortung. Ein gutes Verständnis für Nutzer, Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge. Die Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu strukturieren und Entscheidungen herbeizuführen. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mindestens C1). Hohe Reisebereitschaft (50% Anwesenheit am Standort Würzburg). Warum du bei uns richtig bist Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die nicht nur visionär klingen, sondern die Bauwelt tatsächlich smarter und zukunftsfähig machen – und das Ganze in Projekten und mit Kund:innen, die garantiert nicht langweilig werden. Dabei bist du von Anfang bis Ende mitten im Geschehen und hast ein Team an deiner Seite , das fachlich top ist, menschlich der Knaller und jeden Partybus das Fürchten lehrt. Wir glauben an Flexibilität statt Stechuhr, an Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und an stabile Verhältnisse. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem familienfreundlichen Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen. Außerdem warten Team‑Get‑Aways, gemeinsame Events, Hansefit , ein dickes Benefits‑Paket und eine vernünftige Altersvorsorge auf dich. raw.title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
raw.description:
What we do

At Briink, we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:

  1. Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role. 
  2. Why you’re excited about owning and shipping AI-powered products at Briink. 
  3. Why Briink’s sustainability mission resonates with you.
Upload your video using this form (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or any other solution is fine). We do this to get a better sense of candidates before continuing the process. Any application without a video will not be considered ;)


Your role

As Briink’s Backend/AI Product Engineer, you’ll join a small, high-ownership product and engineering team building AI-powered products for sustainability professionals.

This is not a narrowly scoped backend role. You’ll take meaningful product problems from initial discovery and user conversations through technical design, implementation, and iteration to deploy them at scale across the ESG market. You’ll combine strong backend and AI/LLM engineering with product judgement and the initiative to work out what should be built - not just how to action a predefined ticket.

You will:

  • Own product features end to end, from understanding the user problem and defining the right approach through to delivery, measurement, and improvement.
  • Design and build scalable backend systems, including APIs, data models, workflows, and infrastructure for complex enterprise products.
  • Build and ship applied AI/LLM features, such as LLM chains, RAG systems, tool-using agents, structured-output pipelines, and evaluation workflows
  • Create reusable, extensible platform building blocks that support multiple user journeys and reporting workflows rather than solving each problem in isolation.
  • Improve the robustness of our systems, strengthening reliability, testing, observability, performance, and maintainability as we scale.
  • Work directly with users, product, and data, using qualitative feedback and product data to understand the real problem and evaluate whether a solution works.
  • Prototype and test new AI capabilities, turning promising ideas into practical product improvements that accelerate our roadmap.
  • Bring thoughtful opinions and constructive challenge, helping the team make better product and technical decisions.
  • Collaborate closely with other engineers, including through pair programming, technical design discussions, and shared problem-solving.


Your profile

Technical requirements

  • Strong professional backend engineering experience, with a track record of designing and shipping reliable production systems.
  • Experience in a small, high-ownership product team, ideally within a startup or scale-up engineering organisation of roughly 5–20 engineers.
  • Evidence that you have shipped meaningful products end to end, rather than owning only a narrow component within a much larger organisation.
  • Strong experience in Python (or another modern backend language such as Java, Ruby, or TypeScript, combined with the ability and willingness to become productive in Python quickly).
  • Strong API, database, and systems design skills, with the ability to model complex workflows and build maintainable foundations for enterprise products.
  • Applied AI/LLM experience: you have experience or a strong interest in LLM-powered features, ideally involving RAG or retrieval, tool use, agents, structured outputs, or evaluation systems.
  • A solid software-quality mindset, including testing, code review, CI/CD, observability, and pragmatic approaches to reliability and security.
  • Cloud and container experience, with an understanding of how to deploy, operate, and scale production workloads.
  • Fluent English (C1+), both written and spoken. 
Nice to have
  • Experience building workflow, reporting, questionnaire, or other complex B2B SaaS products.
  • Familiarity with backend technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, background queues 
  • Any experience with LangChain, LangSmith, or other LLM frameworks
  • Deeper experience with RAG, retrieval, agents, LLM evaluation, and production AI systems.
  • Experience improving latency, cost, and reliability for AI workloads.
  • Knowledge of ESG, sustainability, climate tech, or corporate reporting.
  • German language skills.
Who you are
  • Kind and collaborative: You treat people well, communicate clearly, and help create a supportive, low-ego team environment.
  • Mission-driven: You care about using technology to accelerate sustainability and climate action.
  • Sharp and curious: You learn quickly, ask good questions, and enjoy getting to the root of difficult product and technical problems.
  • A product-minded builder: You think beyond the task in front of you, focus on the user’s real problem, and care about whether what you ship creates value.
  • Highly self-directed: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with autonomy, ambiguity, and limited oversight.
  • Pragmatic and action-oriented: You can move from ideas to experiments to production without waiting for perfect requirements.
  • Opinionated but open-minded: You challenge ideas constructively, welcome pushback, and enjoy thinking through problems with others.
  • Commercially aware and creative: You balance technical quality with user needs, business value, and speed.
If your experience doesn’t align precisely with all the criteria, don't worry! We encourage you to still apply. Many people miss out on opportunities because they feel they don’t fit every requirement—we believe in attitude, growth and iteration, not perfection!


What we offer

  • Competitive salary and equity, reflecting your impact and ownership.
  • Purpose-driven mission: Build tools that help organisations act more sustainably and make the ESG data ecosystem more transparent.
  • Flexible hybrid setup: Berlin or London based candidates are strongly preferred, with access to our team and the wider startup community at the Merantix AI Campus.
  • Trust and autonomy: Own meaningful problems, shape the product, and influence how we build as the company grows.
  • A genuinely high-impact role: Increase our delivery capacity, strengthen the robustness of our platform, and accelerate product innovation.
  • Dynamic environment: Work in a small, ambitious team at the intersection of applied AI, enterprise software, and sustainability.
  • Learning budget and quarterly hackathons: Explore new technologies and prototype ideas that push Briink forward.
  • A thoughtful hiring process: We are focused on finding the right person, and are willing to take the time needed to do so.

raw.title: Senior Software Engineer
raw.description:
What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.


The role

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
  • Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
  • Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
  • Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
  • Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
  • Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 


What we need from you

  • You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
  • You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
  • You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
  • You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
  • You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
  • Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
  • Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
  • You communicate clearly and confidently in English


What we offer

  • Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
  • City center office location including home office option  
  • EGYM Wellpass membership support 
  • Educational budget for every employee 
  • Team events, summer & winter parties
  • Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   


Sounds good to you?

Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.   

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. Du optimierst unsere Produktseiten verkaufspsychologisch – von Struktur und Aufbau bis ins Detail. Du baust Upsells, Bundles und Trust-Elemente ein, die den durchschnittlichen Bestellwert messbar steigern. Testing & Analyse Du planst A/B-Tests, wertest sie aus und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab. Du analysierst Conversion Rate, Customer Journey und Bestellwert laufend und erkennst, wo Potenzial liegt. Die nächsten Meilensteine erreichen wir gemeinsam – dafür ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil. Kurze Wege: Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Feedback ist direkt, und gute Ideen werden umgesetzt, nicht vertagt. Dein Impact

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.


In this Internship, you will work on the technical infrastructure behind our revenue engine.


You will work directly with our Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations, and Product teams to identify bottlenecks, build internal tools, automate workflows, connect systems, and deploy AI where it creates measurable commercial impact.


Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Build internal applications and workflows that help SDRs, Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, and leadership make better decisions and execute faster.

  • Turn fragmented processes into scalable systems.


Automate the revenue engine

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success and automate them.

  • Build automations for areas such as lead enrichment, routing, qualification, follow-ups, pipeline management, customer onboarding, and retention.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

  • Experiment rapidly with new models and tools and turn successful experiments into reliable internal products.


Build, don’t just recommend

  • You will personally implement what you design.

  • Depending on the problem, that might mean writing Python or TypeScript, building an n8n workflow, connecting an API, querying a database, prototyping an internal application, or working with our engineers on a deeper integration.

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

  • You have hands-on experience building automations and integrations using tools such as n8n and APIs

  • You are comfortable working with databases, APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines

  • You are interested in Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the systems behind how SAAS companies create revenue 

  • You can translate an ambiguous business problem into a technical solution without needing a detailed specification

  • You move fast, iterate, and are comfortable shipping a first version before everything is perfect

  • You are fluent in English. German or another European language is a plus


Bonus Points

  • You have first experience in a dynamic start-up environment and have worked on technical solutions

  • Tools like HubSpot, Aircall, Stripe, Intercom, PostHog, or similar platforms are not entirely new for you

  • Ideally you have worked on or build internal tools, AI agents, lead-scoring systems, enrichment pipelines, or automated outbound workflows.

  • You have worked in an early-stage or high-growth startup where speed and ownership mattered more than clearly defined responsibilities.


Was wir bieten

An internship with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

You will work directly with leadership, have access to the entire GTM organization, and be able to ship solutions that are used by the team immediately.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description: Abstract Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting. Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception. As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting. These tasks interest you Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences. Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations. Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections. Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility. Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results. That makes you stand out You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field. You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch . You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry , or multi-view vision . Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial. Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level) . Knowledge of German is desirable but not required. Salary information Within our standardized and transparent salary framework, the pay for this position ranges from €15.50 to €19.50 per hour and is based on various factors, such as qualifications and experience. Main information

  • Start: Immediately
  • Location: Cologne, Berlin London or Remote
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Teamwear/Tech


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • 100% remote: This role is generally available 100% remote within the EU or UK. If you'd still love to work from one of our offices in Cologne, Berlin or London - you're more than welcome.
  • Experience: You bring 6-8 years of experience in software engineering and data engineering.
  • Languages: You speak English fluently - German is a big plus.
  • Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.


What you'll do - your playing field

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • Data Pipelines: You build and maintain data pipelines for automated data collection, structured so that new sources and markets can be added quickly.
  • Algorithms: You develop algorithms to extract relevant information from websites and images.
  • Data Quality: You ensure data quality through validation, confidence levels, monitoring, and clean handovers internally and to partners.
  • Data Infrastructure: You manage and further develop the data infrastructure of the Teamwear area.
  • Technical Point of Contact: You act as the second technical point of contact for the Teamwear area.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Internal Tools: You develop internal tools that enable the team to collect and correct data themselves.
  • Analytics & Reports: You create analytics and reports for internal stakeholders and external partners.


What you bring to the team

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Broad Technical Skillset: You move between data pipelines, backend and some frontend, and are not afraid of AI or image analysis.
  • Data Automation: You have experience with automated data pipelines, web scraping and image processing.
  • Databases & Data Modelling: You have expertise in databases and data modelling.
  • Independent Working: You work independently, even when there is no second engineer in the room and the context comes from business teams.
  • Fast Learner: You quickly get familiar with unfamiliar domains and ask the right questions along the way.
  • 80/20 Mindset: You know when fast and good enough is the right approach and when the data needs to be 100% accurate because a decision is based on it.
  • Data Quality: You care about details when it comes to data quality and make uncertainties explicit.
  • Data-Driven Thinking: You don't stop at analysing the data. You identify what is in the data, what it means and what we should look at next - even if nobody asked.
  • Engineering Practice: You write clean, maintainable code and follow good engineering practices such as testing and code reviews.
  • Tools: Python, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, Grafana, Metabase, Pulumi, Kubernetes, AWS, LLM APIs
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • If you are looking for clearly defined tickets, a large engineering team and a finished tech stack, this role is probably not for you.
    • You will work largely as a team of two within Engineering. Most of your day-to-day work will be with business people, not engineers.
    • You have two connections: technically to Engineering and on the content side to the Teamwear team. This gives you a lot of freedom and means you need to set your own priorities.
    • A large part of the role is data collection and data quality, rather than greenfield ML. The exciting part is turning messy, real-world sources into reliable data.
    • The area is new. There is no finished setup for you to work with - you will help build it.
    • AI-first: We work AI-first, and AI tools are an active part of our workflow.


Bonus

Not a must - but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience with AWS, Kubernetes or IaC (Pulumi/Terraform). You can also learn this with us.
  • Experience presenting and preparing data for non-technical audiences.
  • A personal connection to amateur football.


The Prematch Setup

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now. 

  • Be part of it from the start – Shape how Prematch grows and transforms amateur football.
  • Competitive salary – You’ll be paid fairly and transparently.
  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team spirit - whether in the office or at home, we use cool tools and a virtual office to keep the team tightly connected.
  • Modern IT equipment - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.

raw.title: Chief of Staff (All Genders)
raw.description:
Hey!

Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
That's exactly what we're building every single day.


tl;dr

We're looking for a Chief of Staff who works closely with Nik to structurally build out our company- & org processes. 


Main information

  • Start: immediately (flexible start)
  • Location: Cologne
  • Workload: Full-time
  • Team: Founder's Office


Is this a match?

The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.

  • Location: You’ll be based at our office in Cologne (Belgisches Viertel) and should be on site at least twice a week.
  • Experience: You have 5–8 years of experience in strategy & operations and feel confident in your role.
  • Languages are no problem: You speak German and English fluently.
  • Your connection to football: You're genuinely interested in amateur football and have a feel for what moves this community.
  • Start-up spirit: You prefer to play an active part in shaping things rather than just going through the motions – even if that sometimes means tackling things without a ready-made roadmap.


What you'll do - your playing field

This is how you move our mission forward every day.

  • You own selected strategic and operational projects end-to-end. You take projects from the initial idea and concept through planning and execution to measurable results.
  • You build and continuously improve our core company processes. You create clear structures and scalable ways of working that help the organization operate more effectively as we grow.
  • You work closely with Nik on cross-functional strategic projects and priorities. You bring different teams and perspectives together, create clarity on what matters most, and make sure important initiatives move forward.
In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
  • Supporting process optimization in other operational areas as needed
  • Preparing decision-making materials and analyses for the founder team


What you bring to the team

We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.

  • Process & Structure: You think in processes and structures, quickly bring clarity to complex or ambiguous situations, and know how to turn them into pragmatic ways of working.
  • Project Ownership: You have experience independently driving projects from idea to execution in a fast-growing environment and are comfortable taking responsibility for both strategy and implementation.
  • Tools: You are confident working with Notion, project management tools, Google Workspace, and Slack and use them effectively to create transparency, structure, and efficient collaboration
Good to know
We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
  • This role is significantly more hands-on than the title might suggest: you don't just plan, you execute, and take ownership across shifting topic areas. The exact focus will be sharpened further together with the team. If you're looking for pure strategy work without hands-on execution, this role isn't for you.


Bonus

Not a must – but this'll definitely earn you extra points.

  • Experience in a high-growth startup
  • Early experience building People/org processes


The Prematch Setup

We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now.

  • Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
  • Modern tech setup - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
  • AI-powered work - We use AI tools to work smarter and more efficiently, and provide you with the tools you need to make the most of AI in your day-to-day work.
  • 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
  • Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
  • Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
  • Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
  • Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
  • Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.


Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.

If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.
Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us.

The compensation function sits at the heart of that mission: it is the mechanism through which the business acknowledges failures, restores customer confidence, and, when done well, turns a bad experience into a reason to stay.</p> <p>The Associate Director, Customer Compensation &amp; Policy is responsible for the global strategy, architecture, and governance of how HelloFresh compensates customers across all markets and brands. This is not a policy maintenance role. It is a strategic function that sits at the intersection of customer economics, operational data, behavioral experimentation, and cross-functional influence.</p> <p>You will own one of the most financially material and customer-sensitive levers in the business. You will shape a multi-year roadmap and hold peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market Leadership accountable for the quality of inputs that determine how well and how efficiently we recover customer trust.</p> <p><em>The ideal candidate brings a rare combination: analytical rigor sharp enough to architect a global compensation engine from first principles, and the executive presence to drive adoption across a complex, multi-market organization without formal authority over most of the people they need to move.</em></p> <h2>What You'll Own&nbsp;</h2> <p><strong>&nbsp;Global Compensation Strategy &amp; Engine Architecture</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end strategic vision for how HelloFresh categorizes customer errors and determines compensation across all markets, brands, and contact channels.</li> <li>Lead the design and continuous evolution of the compensation engine: along with Tech, you’ll define the the rules, thresholds, segmentation logic, and automation frameworks that govern recovery decisions at scale.</li> <li>Define the principles that govern trade-offs between customer generosity and cost discipline and translate those principles into operational rules that hold across market complexity and brand variation.</li> <li>Partner with Technology to ensure the compensation engine is scalable, auditable, and capable of supporting dynamic, AI-assisted decisioning as the product evolves.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experimentation &amp; Behavioral Economics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the global roadmap for compensation experimentation: A/B testing across offer types, value levels, channel timing, and segmentation variables.</li> <li>Apply behavioral economics frameworks to compensation design understanding how recovery offers shape long-term retention, repurchase behavior, and brand perception, not just immediate satisfaction.</li> <li>Define the measurement framework for experimentation: what constitutes a successful test, what confidence warrants global rollout, and how results are synthesized into durable policy change.</li> <li>Partner with Analytics &amp; Insights to ensure test design, sample integrity, and rollout analysis meet a rigorous standard of evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Stewardship &amp; Cost Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global compensation P&amp;L line: tracking spend by market, error category, customer segment, and channel — and holding yourself accountable to defined cost-per-incident and avoidable-contact targets.</li> <li>Identify and close financial leakage: cases where compensation is being issued without policy justification, at incorrect values, or at the wrong frequency.</li> <li>Build the reporting infrastructure that makes compensation economics visible to GCX leadership, market GMs, and Finance — with the granularity and context needed to drive decisions.</li> <li>Define the right balance between cost optimization and customer lifetime value investment: not just 'spend less' but 'spend where it earns back.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fraud Policy &amp; Global Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the global fraud and abuse prevention framework: the policies, detection logic, thresholds, and escalation paths that protect the business without creating friction for genuine customers.</li> <li>Lead the governance rhythm for policy: quarterly reviews, market exception management, escalation adjudication, and framework versioning across a multi-brand, multi-market environment.</li> <li>Act as the final authority on complex, cross-market policy gaps — resolving ambiguity with speed, consistency, and strategic clarity rather than routing decisions upward by default.</li> <li>Maintain global standards while creating principled space for market-level adaptation where local context genuinely requires it.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership &amp; Stakeholder Accountability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Represent the compensation function in senior forums translating customer economics into requirements that peers in Operations, Technology, Finance, and Market GMs must respond to.</li> <li>Hold cross-functional partners accountable for the upstream data quality, operational accuracy, and system reliability that the compensation engine depends on.</li> <li>Drive adoption of policy changes across markets and brands, building communication and change management plans that make new frameworks land — not just launch.</li> <li>Influence at VP and Director level across multiple functions; escalate only strategic blockers, not routine alignment.</li> </ul> <h2>What You'll Bring&nbsp;</h2> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification required.</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative discipline.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>8–12 years of progressive experience in customer strategy, pricing, operations, or a directly adjacent domain with meaningful exposure to global, multi-market environments.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of owning a financially significant operational lever and managing it with both analytical precision and strategic judgment.</li> <li>Prior experience leading and developing teams; comfort operating as a senior individual contributor and a people leader simultaneously.</li> <li>Background in subscription commerce, logistics, or consumer-facing operations strongly preferred. Familiarity with the economics of customer recovery in high-volume, low-margin environments is a distinct advantage.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical &amp; Analytical</strong></p> <ul> <li>Advanced proficiency in SQL and data analysis; able to build and pressure-test the analytical models that underpin policy decisions without delegating the logic to others.</li> <li>Fluency with experimentation methodology: test design, statistical significance, holdout analysis, and the translation of results into policy not just reporting.</li> <li>Experience working with or alongside engineering teams to define product and system requirements for rules-based or AI-assisted decisioning tools.</li> <li>Comfort with financial modeling: building the business case for compensation investment, forecasting spend impact, and tracking actuals against plan.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Leadership &amp; Influence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Senior executive presence: able to walk into a GM, COO, or CFO conversation with a clear point of view, defend it under pressure, and leave with alignment.</li> <li>A credible voice with peers and upward stakeholders not because of title, but because of the quality of analysis and clarity of communication.</li> <li>Structured and decisive under ambiguity: able to make a defensible call with incomplete information and adjust as evidence develops.</li> <li>Genuinely collaborative across markets and functions able to hold people to standards without damaging the relationships needed to sustain them.</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li><em>Modern and comfortable working space with great co-workers in Berlin-Kreuzberg</em></li> <li><em>Discount for HelloFresh boxes and Convini products</em></li> <li><em>Development possibilities along with internal trainings and a yearly Learning &amp; Development budget</em></li> <li><em>Flexible working hours including Work From Home/Work from Abroad/Sabbatical Policy, as well as a home office set up budget&nbsp;</em></li> <li><em>Extensive Onboarding and Buddy Program</em></li> <li><em>Social events including team events, Friday beers, company runs, book club, etc.</em></li> <li><em>Discounted fitness offers with our Urban Sports Club and John Reed partners and yoga classes</em></li> <li><em>Well-being initiatives in cooperation with Headspace and Spill</em></li> <li><em>Childcare and company pension scheme benefit</em></li> <li><em>Monthly transportation budget via NAVIT</em></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p> <p style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;</p> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: Greif mit uns nach den Sternen! Zur Verstärkung unseres Finance-Teams bei Limehome suchen wir eine:n fachlich starke:n (Senior) Manager Tax – Fokus Umsatzsteuer (m/w/d). Du arbeitest eng mit unseren lokalen Accounting-Teams, diversen internen Stakeholdern sowie externen Beratern zusammen. Damit trägst du unmittelbar zu unserer steuerlichen Compliance und zur Steuerung eines skalierbaren Setups bei. Als ‘Host with heart’ bist du für diese Themen verantwortlich: Umsatzsteuerliche Compliance & Beratung Du verantwortest die umsatzsteuerliche Compliance über alle Gesellschaften und Länder hinweg (u. a. OTA-/Plattformmodelle, grenzüberschreitende Leistungen, Reihengeschäfte). Du arbeitest eng mit den Bereichen Accounting, Financial Systems & Automation sowie den relevanten operativen Teams zusammen, um umsatzsteuerliche Anforderungen in Systeme und automatisierte Workflows zu übersetzen. Du entwickelst Standards, Richtlinien und Dokumentationen weiter und trägst zur Automatisierung und Standardisierung umsatzsteuerlicher Prozesse bei. Prüfungen & externe Stakeholder Du begleitest umsatzsteuerliche Betriebs- und Sonderprüfungen und bereitest die erforderliche Dokumentation vor. Du steuerst externe Steuerberater effektiv, reduzierst externe Beratungskosten und sicherst gleichzeitig die fachliche Qualität. Du unterstützt bei angrenzenden steuerlichen Themen (z. B. Verrechnungspreise, Ertragsteuern). Was Du brauchst, um mit uns nach den Sternen zu greifen: Du verfügst über mehrere Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung im Steuer- und insbesondere im Umsatzsteuerrecht, idealerweise in einem internationalen Umfeld, einer Steuerberatung oder Wirtschaftsprü fung. Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse im deutschen und EU-Umsatzsteuerrecht; Erfahrung mit weiteren europäischen Jurisdiktionen (z. B. Spanien) ist ein klarer Pluspunkt. Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen und hast Freude daran, Fehlerquellen strukturell und nachhaltig zu beheben statt nur Einzelfälle zu korrigieren. Du bringst Erfahrung in der Begleitung von Betriebs- oder Sonderprüfungen mit. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für kontinuierliche Verbesserung sowie den Einsatz von Automatisierung und KI. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sicher in Wort und Schrift und kommunizierst wirksam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern. Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Accounting- und ERP-Systemen sowie gängigen Tools. Darum wirst du deinen “Aufenthalt” bei uns lieben: Hybrides Büromodell: Wir bieten ein flexibles Arbeitsumfeld - Du kannst wählen, ob du zu 100% in unserem Büro oder teilweise von zu Hause und im Büro arbeiten möchtest. Visum & Sprachunterstützung: Wir unterstützen dich bei deinem Visumsprozess und beim Erlernen der deutschen Sprache (nach bestandener Probezeit). Umzugsunterstützung: Wir unterstützen dich finanziell bei deinem Umzug nach München, wenn du weiter als 300 km von unserem Büro entfernt wohnst. Oneteam: Wir sind #oneteam mit einer transparenten Unternehmenskultur, indem wir uns durch Team-Standups, regelmäßige All-Hands und Team-Events (Sommer, Wiesn, Weihnachten) gegenseitig auf dem Laufenden halten. Wachstum und Entwicklung: Wir sorgen dafür, dass du weiter wächst - durch ständiges Feedback, Peer Reviews und Austausch mit Fokus auf deine Entwicklung. Grenzenloses Lernen: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, externe Weiterentwicklungsformate zu nutzen, die dich dabei unterstützen, dein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen, ohne dass du durch ein begrenztest Budget limitiert bist. Workation: Du hast die Möglichkeit, zweimal pro Jahr für eine Dauer von bis zu 4 Wochen in einem anderen Land der Europäischen Union zu arbeiten. Unsere Limehomies lieben das Reisen, deshalb möchten wir dir die Möglichkeit geben, regelmäßig an neuen, inspirierenden Orten zu arbeiten. Sabbatical: Nach deinen 1,5 Jahren bei limehome bieten wir dir die Möglichkeit für ein 3-monatiges Sabbatical. Du kannst diese Zeit nutzen, um zu reisen, Zeit mit deinen Freunden zu verbringen oder dich ehrenamtlich zu engagieren. Alles für unsere Limehomies: Wir kümmern uns um dein körperliches Wohlbefinden (Urban Sports Club) und um dein geistiges Wohlbefinden (Nilo.health). Darüber hinaus profitierst du von vergünstigten Tarifen für unsere Limehomes sowie von vielen weiteren Benefits. Komm zu uns und finde es heraus! 😉 Über Limehome: Limehome ist ein führender, technologiebasierter Hospitality-Betreiber, der funktional gestaltete Designunterkünfte in ganz Europa anbietet. Durch den Einsatz seiner proprietären Technologie ermöglicht Limehome einen reibungslosen und komfortablen Aufenthalt mit einem nahtlosen digitalen Gästeerlebnis für Geschäfts- und Urlaubsreisende. Gegründet im Jahr 2018, beschäftigt Limehome heute über 300 Mitarbeitende und zählt über 10.000 Limehome Apartments und Hotelzimmer in 150 Städten in 13 europäischen Ländern. title: Head of Brand Marketing
description: Why Faculty? We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here . We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence. Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology. AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen. What you will be doing The Head of Brand Marketing ensures that Faculty looks, sounds and shows up like the category leader it is: through a distinctive brand, a body of storytelling with a genuine point of view, a library of sharp assets that bring to life the exceptional work of our teams, and a marketing plan that is tightly aligned to Faculty’s business plan and strategic intent. It is delivered with a standard of craft that means nothing about Faculty ever feels accidental. Strategic Responsibilities This role has two core mandates: 1. Brand Strategy & Differentiation You will be the primary custodian of the Faculty brand. Differentiating and elevating Faculty is a core strategic priority: you will position the company as the clear leader in applied AI, building reputation through bold, opinionated storytelling rather than the vague futurism that dominates so much of AI marketing. 2. Marketing Strategy & Delivery You will co-create Faculty’s marketing strategy with the Director of Marketing and Communications, and develop and own the marketing plan that brings it to life, in line with Faculty's overall business plan and strategic intent. You will hold the bar for excellence in marketing delivery: every asset matches the premium feel of our brand, every campaign is executed with purpose and precision, every narrative is crisp and intentional. You will oversee events, digital, creative and content, making sure everything we produce is sharp, crisp, high quality and unmistakably Faculty. Key Deliverables: Brand & Narrative Primary custodian of the Faculty brand Foundational assets: corporate and commercial narratives, brand guidelines, case studies, canonical assets, ensuring central assets are culturally sensitive and travel well Faculty differentiation: build Faculty’s reputation as a leader in applied AI through powerful storytelling about our work and opinionated perspectives on applied AI Marketing Strategy & Planning Develop and own the marketing plan, ensuring it is tightly aligned to the business plan and able to flex as priorities shift. Sit as a core member of the Marketing Leadership Team, shaping decisions that affect the wider function and bringing a brand and marketing lens to the leadership table. Use data and audience insight to prioritise investment, favouring durable brand equity and growth over vanity metrics. Marketing Delivery Ensure every asset matches the premium feel of the Faculty brand and speaks directly to the audiences it's built for Execute with purpose and precision: every campaign, launch and piece of content should have a clear reason to exist and a clear standard it's held to. Set and protect a language standard that is parsimonious and human: no jargon, no filler, no vague futurism, just clear, confident writing that respects the reader. Digital, Creative & Content Oversight Oversee digital, creative, events, and content, ensuring every output is intentional, high quality and unmistakably Faculty. Direct creative development across campaigns, visual identity applications, video and design, holding a high bar for craft. Partner with the Head of Storytelling - who owns thought leadership and the lab-driven POV - to ensure content and creative output reinforce the same brand narrative and a consistent standard of storytelling. Leadership & Collaboration Partner closely with Marketing and Communications Leadership to develop and deliver integrated strategies. Lead, coach and develop a team spanning digital, events, creative and brand disciplines, raising individual capability while staying hands-on where your own judgement adds most value. Bring bold ideas, energy and vision, challenging marketing orthodoxies to bring Faculty marketing to a new level Lead the team to become truly AI-native - using AI tools to work faster and push craft further, as well as identifying opportunities to deploy AI-enabled marketing tools and skills across the business Support the international expansion of the Faculty brand, working with regional colleagues to ensure it travels well and adapts where it needs to. Who we're looking for Significant experience in the technology / AI space Proven ability to build and own a brand strategy for a technology brand, from foundational narratives through to visual identity and tone of voice A proven ability to find the story in complex, technical material and tell it with clarity, confidence and a genuine point of view, with an instinct for which formats will make it land. Experience co-creating and owning a marketing plan tightly aligned to business strategy, translating ambition into a deliverable, resourced plan. A strong eye and a high bar. Experience directing creatives, designers and agencies to produce work that is sharp and distinctive. A track record of holding a team to intentional, deliberate and precise execution: premium assets, purposeful campaigns, and writing that is parsimonious and human Experience owning a company's digital platforms and driving brand equity, not just lead volume. Comfortable partnering with editorial and content leads to ensure output reinforces brand positioning and a consistent point of view. A sharp instinct for what makes a brand distinctive in a crowded category, and the conviction to say no to generic execution. Skilled at working alongside C-suite leaders and technical experts, earning trust quickly through sound judgement and a bias for delivery. An ability to operate at the upper echelons of a business, and to show how brand and marketing strategy is aligned to commercial goals and actively helping achieve them. Proven ability to lead, coach and develop a multi-disciplinary team. A player-coach who neither hides behind the team nor bottlenecks it. Deep understanding of AI, its transformative potential when deployed at enterprise and government scale, its associated risks, and the current landscape of global AI policy and safety discourse. Highly self-sufficient, with the flexibility and tenacity to thrive in a fast-paced, complex scale-up environment now operating at global scale. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations. If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours. A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews.
